description: Parliament of Sri Lanka - Convening of the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka on Tuesday 2nd of July 2024 at 9.30 a.m
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification from the Speaker of Parliament convening a parliamentary session on a specific date and time. This falls under electoral and parliamentary processes, specifically the scheduling and convening of parliamentary sessions, which aligns with Type 7 (Elections Gazettes) covering "Election announcements and schedules" and parliamentary proceedings.
